profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: I am a technical lead who enjoys making things simpler, helping teams grow, empower people's careers, and foster a happy and positive environment. I also write whenever I have time, and I just published my first book: https://elcepilanansa.com/producte/antoni-visita-catalunya/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Making FPGA inferencing in the Cloud possible.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
◆ Developed high availability and highly scalable cool stuff in the Customer Reviews team.
◆ Contributed in the re-design and re-architecture of the whole Customer Reviews platform.
◆ Playing with deep convolutional neural networks for Amazon Fashion.

positions.title: R&D Computer Vision Engineer
positions.description:
◆ Research, design and implement computer vision algorithms for marketing analytics systems.
◆ Actively fighting against computer vision problems to keep increasing the accuracy and reducing costs.
◆ Design and develop APIs and graphical applications for managing the whole database of the system.
◆ Main technologies used: C++, OpenCV, Qt, boost, Java, PostgreSQL, and MATLAB.

positions.title: Chief Software Architect
positions.description:
◆ Design and develop core software products of the company, in the fields of smart farming and medical imaging, among others.
◆ Design and develop high avaliability fast and reliable server-based cloud computing applications from the scratch, developing highly optimized CPU and GPU computer vision and machine learning algorithms.
◆ Main technologies used: C++, OpenCV, Qt, boost, CUDA... all on a Raspberry Pi! and MATLAB.

positions.title: Chief Software Architect / R&D Computer Vision Engineer
positions.description:
◆ Design and develop core software packages of the company, a time-constrained critical multi-threaded embedded application.
◆ Design and develop computer vision algorithms for different traffic applications: ANPR, red light enforcement, 3D speed measurement, among others.
◆ Lead and guide a team of engineers to ensure the success of the development team.
◆ Main technologies used: C++, OpenCV, Qt, boost, ffmpeg, .NET among others.

positions.title: R&D Biometrics Engineer
positions.description:
◆ Research and implementation of a complete iris recognition system, including the capture from the device, image processing, image enhancement, segmentation, and recognition algorithm, comparison between samples, and full implementation of an access control GUI with entries monitoring and user administration.
◆ Research and improvement stages of projects focused on face recognition, such as biometric surveillance, access control and massive search in images and video, as part of the research team and in the development and design team.
◆ Design and implementation of management systems for centralized databases of biometric applications.
◆ Main technologies used: C#, .NET, WPF, PostgreSQL, MATLAB, C++, among others.

positions.title: Research Assistant / Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
◆ Development and maintenance of signal processing software and speech recognition systems in European project CHIL (Computers in Human Interaction Loop) and Spanish and Catalan founded project SAPIRE and TECNOPARLA.
◆ Development and maintenance of some graphical applications under Windows and Linux.
◆ Server and net maintenance.
◆ Maintenance of an audio software project based on audio signal processing in smart rooms environments, such as audio recording, processing, and research assistance to PhDs who developed automatic speech recognition systems, speaker identification, location tracking, diarization and acoustic event detection.

projects.title: Logos
projects.description: An algorithm for logo recognition and localization in videos.

projects.title: L'Antoni visita Catalunya (Children's illustration book)
projects.description: A children's illustration book about a little boy that visits Catalonia with his dog. Throughout their journey, they learn about the Catalan language, Catalan children's songs and interesting locations within the country.

publications.title: L'Antoni visita Catalunya
publications.publisher: El Cel i la Nansa · Apr 4, 2023

publications.title: A Novel Method for Low-constrained Iris Boundary Localization
publications.publisher: 5th IAPR International Conference on Biometrics, New Delhi, India · Mar 1, 2012
